A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the MTX-loaded nanoparticles (NPs), in particular those based on glycol chitosans (GCS), represent a promising strategy to overcome the Pg-p efflux mechanism of the blood–brain tumor barrier and enhance the delivery of the drug to the tumor.
the MTX-loaded NPs are able to overcome MDKII-MDR1 efflux system.

chitosan- and glycolchitosan-based MTX-loaded nanoparticles can be a good strategy for the delivery of MTX to the brain and overcome the efflux of Pg-p.
